directions.name: Warm Rhyming Couplet
directions.refrain:
Rada vas imam zelo,
ker z vami mi je res lepo.
directions.approach: A gentle two-line refrain built on the clear zelo–lepo rhyme, with an even cadence for repeated read-aloud use.
directions.genderDependency: The mushroom narrator is grammatically feminine, so the fixed form is »rada«.

directions.name: Playful Call and Response
directions.refrain:
Koga imam rada, kdo me razveseli?
Moji prijatelji — prav vsi!
directions.approach: An energetic question-and-answer refrain with a strong final reveal and the genuine razveseli–vsi rhyme.
directions.genderDependency: The mushroom narrator is grammatically feminine, so the fixed form is »rada«.

directions.name: Compact Rhyming Tag
directions.refrain: Rada vas imam, prav vsem to priznam!
directions.approach: A short closing tag with a crisp imam–priznam rhyme, designed to land firmly at the end of each spread.
directions.genderDependency: The mushroom narrator is grammatically feminine, so the fixed form is »rada«.
